name: Volume Booster - Music Player
description:
Your all-in-one music controller center.
The app works with all devices through AirPlay, Wifi, Bluetooth, TVCast and more. Create personalized playlists and enjoy the music immediately.

• This is a powerful Volume Booster. Volume Booster is a simple way to make your iPhone sound louder!

• Smart connect any speakers, headphones, TVCast, CarPlay that support AirPlay & Bluetooth with our app. Powerful Equalizer with personalized bass & treble.

• Extra Volume Booster ensures that there is no distortion when increasing the volume, so that all sounds of low-level audio files or weak microphone speakers can be clearer and stronger.

• Play offline (no data or Wi-Fi connection needed after downloading music).

• Custom Equalizer presets for each playlist. 

• Improve the low quality sound files to louder and higher quality.

• Play music in background. Lock screen playback controls.
